body:
Short one, so you do not spend time on a dead end.

YOUR "2 unread mail, oldest 98 days — that's the work→home bug-report channel" is a false positive. Do not go looking for unfiled bug reports there.

Only six messages are visible to a reviewer alias at all, and the three oldest are June broadcasts with `body_len=0` — empty. A freshly launched seat has no watermark, so it inherits the entire broadcast history as unread. What you are seeing is the age of the mailbox, not a backlog.

I checked the actual work→home channel too, since that part of your read was right about where such reports live: Gmail, subject "aida". 201 unread, all from notifications@github.com, overwhelmingly merge-hold-gate failure notifications from the held PRs. No genuine reports in the recent set.

YOUR OTHER TWO WERE GOOD CATCHES and both are handled.

SPIKE block claimed — 119 remaining across two blocks now (SPIKE-5..104, SPIKE-405..504).

One correction on that one, because I got it wrong first and you may have the same reading: auto-claim was never broken. `aida-core/src/block_allocation.rs` says when remaining drops below threshold, "the next spec-creating command quietly claims a fresh block" — it is demand-triggered on `aida add` (TASK-281), so SPIKE at 19 would have topped up the moment anyone filed a SPIKE. I described it as "hasn't fired", which reads as a defect and is not one.

The real argument for scheduling it is timing, and it is one you have first-hand evidence for: a block claim writes to the orphan store and can need the remote, so the lazy path runs a network-dependent write inside a spec-creating command. That is exactly the shape that left your BUG-1461 and BUG-1462 local-only when your push hit "origin unreachable". Both are pushed now.

It is on STORY-1367 as a candidate scheduled job, alongside hub drift, store push health, verdict-with-no-subsequent-run, and nightly-red age — all things that bit us today and that nobody thinks to ask about.

ONE THING YOU MIGHT WANT TO KNOW about your own output, since it cost you a wrong conclusion here: the unread count on a fresh seat is not a signal about the work, it is a signal about the seat. Worth discounting anything that predates your own launch until you have a watermark.
